BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                             OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
 In the Matter of Union Electric Company )
                                                            Case No. ER-2026-0291
 d/b/a Ameren Missouri's Tariff to Adjust Its )
 Revenues for Electric Service                )

               MOTION FOR ADDITIONAL LOCAL PUBLIC HEARING

       Comes now the Office of the Public Counsel (the “OPC”) and respectfully requests that

the Commission hold an additional in-person local public hearing in or near Festus, MO, at 6:00

p.m. on January 25, 2027. In support, the OPC respectfully states:

       1. On June 26, 2026, Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri (“Ameren”) filed

           this case, seeking an increase of approximately $342.8 million, or approximately 10.4%

           in its overall revenue requirement. (Minimum Filing Requirements 4, Doc. 2).

       2. Ameren estimates that the proposed increase for the average residential customer will

           be approximately $12.88 per month. (Meyer Direct Test., Schedule AMM-D1 1,

           Doc. 13).

       3. On October 9, 2026, the Staff of the Public Service Commission of the State of

           Missouri (“Staff” and “Commission,” respectively), Ameren, and the OPC filed the

           Jointly Proposed Local Public Hearing Schedule requesting that the Commission

           schedule five (5) in-person local public hearings and two (2) virtual local public

           hearings. (Doc. 55).

       4. The locations for the jointly proposed in-person local public hearings are: (1) Cape

           Girardeau; (2) St. Charles, (3) St. Louis, (4) Jefferson City, and (5) Sunset Hills.

           (Jt. Proposed Local Pub. Hearing Schedule 1). Staff, Ameren, and the OPC suggested

           that the Commission hold the St. Charles and St. Louis local public hearings on the



                                               1
                same day and the Sunset Hills local public hearing on a different day (January 25, 2027)

               at 12:00 p.m. (Id.).

           5. The Jointly Proposed Local Public Hearing Schedule also recognized that the OPC

               would be requesting an additional in-person local public hearing by separate motion.

           6. By this motion, the OPC requests that the Commission hold an additional in-person

               local public hearing in or near Festus, MO, at 6:00 p.m. on January 25, 2027.

           7. Generally, holding this additional local public hearing will allow members of the public

               an even greater opportunity to appear in-person before the Commission to state their

               opinions on Ameren’s rate increase request. This is Ameren’s fourth (4th) request for

               a rate increase in the last five (5) calendar years. (See ER-2024-0319, ER-2022-0337,

               ER-2021-0240). Members of the public have already submitted three hundred and ten

               (310) written comments1 to the Commission’s case file for this case.               The

               Commission’s recent local public hearings held in other Ameren cases have also been

               well-attended. In fact, the Commission sua sponte scheduled an additional in-person

               local public hearing in a recent Ameren case. (See generally Order Setting Additional

               Local Pub. Hearing, Case No. EA-2026-0183, Doc. 34).

           8. The OPC specifically requests that the Commission hold the additional local public

               hearing in Festus, as this is the first general rate case following the Commission’s

               consideration of the Big Hollow simple cycle natural gas electric generation facility

               and battery energy storage system (collectively, the “Big Hollow Project”), which

               Ameren is constructing in Jefferson County, near Festus. (See Appl. 3, Case No. EA-

               2025-0238, Doc. 2). Likely due to timing considerations regarding the public notice,


1
    As of 4:15 p.m. on October 13, 2026.


                                                    2
            the Commission did not hold an in-person local public hearing in the case in which it

           considered Ameren’s request for Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Big

           Hollow Project. Concern regarding the lack of an in-person local public hearing was

           noted during the virtual local public hearing held in that case. Similarly, Festus

           provides those Ameren customers living in the area south of the St. Louis metro area

           an opportunity to attend an in-person local public hearing within a reasonable driving

           distance of their home.

       9. Finally, holding the additional local public hearing at 6:00 p.m. on the same day as the

           Sunset Hills in-person local public hearing will promote travel logistics for those who

           attend the local public hearing for the Commission, Staff, Ameren, and the OPC.

       WHEREFORE, the Office of the Public Counsel submits this Motion for Additional Local

Public Hearing and requests that the Commission hold an in-person local public hearing in or near

Festus, MO, at 6:00 p.m. on January 25, 2027, in addition to those requested in the Jointly Proposed

Local Public Hearing Schedule.

                                                       Respectfully submitted,

                                                         /s/ Lindsay VanGerpen
                                                       Lindsay VanGerpen (#71213)
                                                       Senior Counsel
                                                       Missouri Office of the Public Counsel
                                                       P.O. Box 2230
                                                       Jefferson City, MO 65102

to all counsel of record this 13th day of October 2026.
